# TVL Academy

> AI consultancy and training for companies, delivered by TVL Tech: AI strategy and adoption, EU AI Act compliance and governance, and practical training for corporate teams. Consultanță și training AI pentru companii — strategie AI, conformitate EU AI Act și training practic.

TVL Academy runs a 3-session, 9-hour program that takes a team from chaotic AI use to a standardized, correct and consistent way of working. It is customized to the client company's real processes, tools and roles, and delivered on-site anywhere in Romania or online. Trainer: Alexandru Dan, CEO of TVL Tech, Generative AI lecturer at ASE Bucharest and creator of the CROTATFC prompting framework. The three sessions cover prompt engineering (CROTATFC), building a personalized AI assistant per role, and an AI Design Sprint for prioritizing automation. Teams leave with a prompt library, per-role AI assistants, a 3–5 item automation plan, audit-ready EU AI Act compliance documentation, individual certificates, and 30 days of email support. Ideal group size is 10–20 participants. Available in Romanian and English.

## Pages
- [Program AI pentru echipe (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/): main Romanian landing page — program, sessions, deliverables, FAQ, booking.
- [AI training program (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/): main English landing page.
- [TVL AI Skills (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/skills/): skill-uri Agent reutilizabile de la TVL pentru ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code și instrumente compatibile Agent Skills. Sursa de instalare este repository-ul GitHub `danlex/tvl-skills`; skill-urile individuale sunt `tvl-write-linkedin-post`, `tvl-design-diagram`, `tvl-ethical-ai-audit` și `tvl-detect-ai-writing` (detectează tipare formulaice de AI în text și dă un scor de la 0 la 10).
- [TVL AI Skills (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/skills/): reusable Agent Skills by TVL for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code and compatible Agent Skills tools. The install source is the GitHub repository `danlex/tvl-skills`; individual skills include `tvl-write-linkedin-post`, `tvl-design-diagram`, `tvl-ethical-ai-audit`, and `tvl-detect-ai-writing` (detects formulaic AI writing patterns in text and returns a 0-10 Pattern Score). Install all with `npx skills add danlex/tvl-skills`, or one skill with `npx skills add danlex/tvl-skills --skill tvl-detect-ai-writing`. Source: https://github.com/danlex/tvl-skills

## Services
Beyond the training program, TVL offers advisory services for companies adopting AI. All work is advisory: TVL never asks for system access or credentials, so the client keeps control of its systems and data.
- [AI consultancy (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/services/): hub for TVL's three services — EU AI Act compliance and governance, AI strategy and adoption, and AI training. Built on the client's real processes.
- [Consultanță AI (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/servicii/): Romanian version of the AI consultancy hub.
- [EU AI Act compliance (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/services/eu-ai-act-compliance/): advisory service that maps a company's AI use against the EU AI Act, classifies risk (prohibited, high-risk under Annex III, limited, minimal), puts governance controls and an AI registry in place, covers the Article 4 AI literacy obligation (in force since 2 February 2025), and produces audit-ready documentation. Includes an EU AI Act readiness checklist.
- [Conformitate EU AI Act (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/servicii/conformitate-eu-ai-act/): Romanian version of the EU AI Act compliance service.
- [AI strategy and adoption (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/services/ai-strategy/): advisory service that identifies and prioritizes AI use cases by impact and risk, produces a 90-day adoption roadmap, and defines a human-and-agent operating model teams can run.
- [Strategie și adopție AI (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/servicii/strategie-ai/): Romanian version of the AI strategy and adoption service.

## Articles
- [EU AI Act: ce trebuie să demonstreze companiile despre angajați (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/eu-ai-act-angajati/): explains the "AI literacy" obligation in Article 4 of the EU AI Act (in force since 2 February 2025) — what "sufficient" means, what the law does not require (no specific certificate, no separate fixed fine), and how a company can demonstrate compliance.
- [EU AI Act: what companies must prove about their employees (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/eu-ai-act-employees/): English version of the EU AI Act / AI literacy article.
- [How to Rank in ChatGPT: a GEO & AEO playbook (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/how-to-rank-in-chatgpt/): an eight-step playbook to get pages cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews — allow the AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), answer in the first two sentences, structure sections as question and answer, add Article/FAQPage/HowTo schema, cite sources and statistics, clarify author and publisher, keep the page fresh, and publish an llms.txt. GEO research (Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024) found citations, quotations and statistics raised AI-answer visibility by up to 40%.
- [Cum să apari în ChatGPT: ghid GEO și AEO (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/cum-sa-apari-in-chatgpt/): Romanian version of the how-to-rank-in-ChatGPT / GEO playbook.
- [AI Literacy Training for Employees: a 2026 guide (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/ai-literacy-training-for-employees/): what AI literacy is (Long & Magerko, CHI 2020), whether it is legally required (yes in the EU, under Article 4 of the EU AI Act since 2 February 2025, proportional, no fixed certificate but the burden of proof is on the company), what training should cover (what AI can and cannot do, prompting, data confidentiality, verifying output, when not to use AI, company rules), and a six-step way to run it that produces a documented trail.
- [Alfabetizare AI pentru angajați: ghid 2026 (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/alfabetizare-ai-pentru-angajati/): Romanian version of the AI literacy training for employees guide.
- [How to Build AI Agents with Claude: a 2026 guide (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/how-to-build-ai-agents-with-claude/): what an AI agent is (a language model running in a loop with tools: decide, call a tool, read the result, repeat until done), when you actually need one versus a single prompt or a fixed workflow (start simple; use an agent only for open-ended tasks worth the cost where errors can be recovered), and the building blocks Claude gives you — tool use via the Messages API, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Claude Agent SDK, and Claude Code — plus a seven-step playbook and model guidance (Opus 4.8 for hard long-horizon work, Sonnet 4.6 balanced, Haiku 4.5 fast).
- [Cum construiești agenți AI cu Claude: ghid 2026 (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/cum-construiesti-agenti-ai-cu-claude/): Romanian version of the how-to-build-AI-agents-with-Claude guide.
- [AI Training for Sales Teams: what to cover and how to run it (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/ai-training-for-sales-teams/): department-specific AI training for sales — the use cases that pay off first (account research, drafting and personalizing outreach, call prep, turning calls into CRM notes, follow-ups, first-draft proposals), what the training should cover (the tools, prompting for human-sounding outreach, data confidentiality, checking claims before they reach a customer), a six-step way to run it on the team's real pipeline, and why AI augments reps rather than replacing them.
- [Training AI pentru echipe de vânzări (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/training-ai-pentru-echipe-de-vanzari/): Romanian version of the AI training for sales teams guide.
- [AI Training for HR Teams (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/ai-training-for-hr-teams/): department AI training for HR — use cases (drafting job descriptions, summarizing CVs for a human to decide, policy Q&A from your handbook, onboarding, structured records), what to cover, a six-step run, and the rule that a person makes every people decision. Under the EU AI Act, AI in recruitment and employment decisions is high-risk, so AI prepares and a person decides.
- [Training AI pentru echipe HR (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/training-ai-pentru-echipe-hr/): Romanian version of the AI training for HR teams guide.
- [AI Training for Finance Teams (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/ai-training-for-finance-teams/): department AI training for finance — use cases (reporting commentary, reconciliation prep, summarizing contracts, first-draft variance analysis, plain-language explanations), what to cover, a six-step run, and the rule that AI drafts the words while a person verifies every figure against the source and owns the sign-off.
- [Training AI pentru echipe de finanțe (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/training-ai-pentru-echipe-de-finante/): Romanian version of the AI training for finance teams guide.
- [AI Training for Marketing Teams (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/ai-training-for-marketing-teams/): department AI training for marketing — use cases (first drafts, campaign briefs, research summaries, repurposing, ad and subject-line variations, analytics summaries), what to cover, a six-step run, and the rule that you configure the brand voice on real published work and keep a human edit that checks every claim, so output stays on brand and not generic.
- [Training AI pentru echipe de marketing (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/training-ai-pentru-echipe-de-marketing/): Romanian version of the AI training for marketing teams guide.
- [Blog (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/): index of Romanian articles.
- [Blog (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/): index of English articles.

## FAQ
- **What is TVL Academy?** A practical AI training program for corporate teams, delivered by TVL Tech. It runs 3 sessions over 9 hours and moves a team from ad-hoc AI use to a standardized, correct, consistent way of working, customized to the company's real processes, tools, and roles.
- **Who is it for?** Corporate teams of 10 to 20 people that already use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini but without a shared standard. It is delivered in Romanian or English, on-site anywhere in Romania or online.
- **What does the program cover?** Three sessions: prompt engineering with the CROTATFC framework; building a personalized AI assistant per role; and an AI Design Sprint that prioritizes automation opportunities.
- **What do teams leave with?** A prompt library, per-role AI assistants, a 3 to 5 item automation plan, audit-ready EU AI Act compliance documentation, individual certificates, and 30 days of email support.
- **Does it cover EU AI Act compliance?** Yes. The program produces documentation that helps demonstrate the AI literacy obligation in Article 4 of the EU AI Act, in force since 2 February 2025.
- **Who is the trainer?** Alexandru Dan, CEO of TVL Tech, Generative AI lecturer at ASE Bucharest, and creator of the CROTATFC prompting framework.
- **Does TVL offer AI consultancy beyond training?** Yes. TVL provides advisory services for companies: EU AI Act compliance and governance (risk classification, an AI registry, Article 4 AI literacy, audit-ready documentation), and AI strategy and adoption (prioritized use cases, a 90-day roadmap, a human-and-agent operating model). All work is advisory, so the client keeps control of its systems and data.
- **Does TVL work on AI search visibility and GEO?** Yes. TVL publishes an open-source SEO and GEO audit skill, `tvl-seo-geo-audit`, that checks pages for technical SEO, structured data, crawler policy, and generative-engine answer visibility.
